description: Admin agents and owners. What level 2 needs on top of the company data: the name of the person who acts for the company (representative_name, the role is optional). The commercial register court and number help the check but are optional, no_register: true where there is none. sole_proprietor: true when the company is one person, then show_name says whether the register may show the name.

no_register.description: true when the company is in no commercial register

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

register_court.description: The court or office that keeps the register, where the country names one: Registergericht in Germany, Firmenbuchgericht in Austria. GET /v1/countries names it per country

register_number.description: The number in the register, as the register writes it (GET /v1/countries names the register per country)

representative_name.description: The name of the person who acts for the company. null clears it

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

show_name.description: With sole_proprietor: whether the register may show the name

sole_proprietor.description: true when the company is one person
